### Guilty?
Author: Jana Kelley
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/guilty-wholly-loved-august-7.html
Passage: Romans 8:1
Points:
- Like a criminal defendant awaiting sentencing, every person deserves a guilty verdict before God because of sin.
- Human striving and personal effort can never achieve the perfection God requires.
- Jesus lived the only perfect life and bore our deserved punishment on the cross.
- Trusting in Christ unites us with Him and completely removes our condemnation through God's mercy.

### How to Be Spiritually Minded
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/how-to-be-spiritually-minded
Passage: Romans 8:6
Points:
- Setting our mindset on the Spirit is vital because it brings true life and peace.
- Worldly entertainment and daily distractions easily lure the mind away from God.
- Having the mindset of the Spirit means viewing ordinary life through an enduring awareness of God.
- Believers cultivate spiritual-mindedness by anchoring joy in God, meditating on eternity, and praying for renewed hearts.
